title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
summary: On 2026-09-01, Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, introducing a senior model and a variant with weakened cyber/biology filters for verified organizations, updated benchmark results, revised pricing with 75% cheaper cache reads, Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with zero data retention, and AI Act-mandated textual watermarking.
